items.summary: In frontend/src/data/services.ts, reduce every painting package price by exactly ₹1. For example: ₹18/sqft → ₹17/sqft, ₹19 → ₹18, ₹17 → ₹16, ₹13 → ₹12, ₹9 → ₹8, ₹5 → ₹4. Apply to all painting service entries. Do not change any other field, layout, or card design.

In frontend/src/data/services.ts and frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceCard.tsx, update cleaning service prices to: Bathroom – ₹449, Sofa – ₹699, Mattress – ₹799, Kitchen – ₹1499. For home cleaning, set prices to: 1BHK Vacant – ₹2499, 1BHK Occupied – ₹3499, 2BHK Vacant – ₹3999, 2BHK Occupied – ₹4999, 3BHK Vacant – ₹5999, 3BHK Occupied – ₹6999. For Villa, Commercial, and Carpet cleaning entries, replace the price display with the flow label 'Free Inspection → Quote → Service'. Do not change card layout or design.

In frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx, ensure that when a user navigates to or selects the Pest Control, Cleaning, or Painting service, only that service's own subcategory cards are rendered. No cards or sections from other services must appear on the same view. The service detail page must be fully isolated per service.

In frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx, for bookings where the service type is Pest Control, Cleaning, or Painting, add a 'Property Type' select field with options: 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, Square Feet, Villa, Commercial. This field should only be visible when one of these three service types is selected. Do not change the booking form layout for other service types.

Update every button and CTA in the frontend — including 'Free Inspection', 'Book Now', 'Call', and the floating WhatsApp button — to open the URL https://wa.me/918884447229. Verify this applies to: FloatingWhatsAppButton.tsx, HeroSection.tsx, PestControlCard.tsx, CleaningServiceCard.tsx, PaintingServiceCard.tsx, ServiceCard.tsx, SubcategoryCard.tsx, and any other component with a booking or call CTA. Do not change button appearance or layout.
